mainTopic: Kiddushin 36b: Finishing the sources for the Temple services in the משנה that only men do (קבלה, הזאה), and starting on the exception of מנחת סוטה and מנחת נזירה, which the women themselves wave.
overview: The משנה listed Temple services that only male כהנים do, not women, except for the מנחת סוטה and the מנחת נזירה, which the women wave themselves. The גמרא finishes the source for קבלת הדם. Then it asks which הזאה the משנה means. It rules out the פרה אדומה and the inner sprinklings, and settles on the sprinkling of a bird offering, proved by a קל וחומר from a sheep offering. Next it turns to the exception. רבי אלעזר asks רבי יאשיה where we learn that the owner herself waves the מנחת סוטה. The answer is a גזירה שוה of 'יד' from שלמים: the כהן and the owner both wave, with the כהן's hand under the owner's hand. The נזירה is then learned from the סוטה through the word 'כף'. Finally, a new משנה begins: מצוות that depend on the land apply only in ארץ ישראל, and all others apply everywhere.

steps.title: The source for receiving the blood
steps.stepSummary: The word 'והקריבו' in the פסוק about the בני אהרן refers to קבלת הדם, so only כהנים, not women, receive the blood.
steps.simpleTranslation: 'And they shall present': this means receiving the blood.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes its source for why קבלה (receiving the blood) is only for male כהנים. The word 'והקריבו' means receiving the blood.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק says 'והקריבו בני אהרן', 'the sons of אהרן shall present'. Reading 'presenting' as קבלת הדם ties that service to בני אהרן, the male כהנים. That is why women are excluded from it.

keyTerms.meaning: Receiving the animal's blood in a holy vessel
'And they shall present', from the פסוק
The sons of אהרן, the male כהנים

phrases.english: "And they shall present" —
this is the receiving of the blood.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the source for קבלות, the item from the משנה's list that came just before this point.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: קבלת הדם is learned from 'והקריבו בני אהרן', so it needs a male כהן.

steps.title: Which sprinkling does the משנה mean?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes 'הזאות' from the משנה and asks which kind of sprinkling it is talking about.
steps.simpleTranslation: And sprinklings. Which sprinkling is meant?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves to the next item on the משנה's list, הזאות, and asks which sprinkling is meant. This sets up the next steps, where it checks each option.
steps.deeperAnalysis: There are several kinds of הזאה in the Temple. Some of them already obviously exclude women. So the גמרא wants to know which one the משנה needed to teach us about.

phrases.english: And sprinklings.
Which sprinkling is this?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on from קבלה to the next service in the משנה's list.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which type of הזאה is the משנה referring to when it says women may not do it?

steps.title: Ruling out the red heifer and the inner sprinklings
steps.stepSummary: The הזאה of the פרה אדומה can't be meant, because it is done by אלעזר. The inner הזאה can't be meant either, because it is done by the כהן משיח.
steps.simpleTranslation: If it is the red heifer, the פסוק says 'אלעזר' about it. If it is the sprinkling inside, the פסוק says 'the anointed כהן' about it.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא rules out two possible sprinklings. For each one, a פסוק already names a special כהן to do it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If even an ordinary כהן can't do these sprinklings, women obviously can't. The משנה would have no reason to teach that. So the משנה must mean a sprinkling that ordinary כהנים do.

keyTerms.meaning: אלעזר the כהן, son of אהרן
Inside: blood sprinkled inside, not on the outer מזבח

phrases.english: If it is of the red heifer,
"Elazar" is written about it.
If it is of inside,
phrases.notes: He means blood sprinkled inside, not on the outer מזבח.

phrases.english: "The anointed priest" is written about it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts answering the question by eliminating options.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects the פרה אדומה and the inner sprinklings as what the משנה meant.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: Those sprinklings already need a special כהן, so women being excluded is obvious and needs no teaching.

steps.title: It means sprinkling the blood of a bird offering
steps.stepSummary: The משנה is talking about the הזאה of a bird offering.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, it is the sprinkling of a bird offering.
steps.whatsHappening: Since the other options were ruled out, the גמרא concludes the משנה means sprinkling the blood of a bird offering (בן עוף).
steps.deeperAnalysis: With a bird offering, the פסוק doesn't openly say 'כהן' for the sprinkling. So we need a source that women can't do it, and the next step gives one.

phrases.english: Rather, the sprinkling of a bird offering,

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After ruling out the other options, gives the answer.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The משנה's הזאות refers to the sprinkling of a bird offering's blood.

steps.title: A קל וחומר from a sheep offering
steps.stepSummary: A sheep offering may be slaughtered by anyone, yet its sprinkling needs a כהן. A bird offering's מליקה already needs a כהן, so surely its sprinkling needs a כהן too.
steps.simpleTranslation: This comes from a קל וחומר from a sheep offering. A sheep's slaughter needs no כהן, yet its sprinkling does. A bird's מליקה does need a כהן, so isn't it logical that its sprinkling needs one too?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא proves that a bird offering's sprinkling needs a כהן by using a קל וחומר (a 'how much more so' argument) from a sheep offering.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For a sheep, the Torah is strict about the sprinkling even though it is easy about the slaughter. For a bird, the Torah is strict even about the מליקה, the bird's version of slaughter. So it must surely be strict about the bird's sprinkling.

keyTerms.meaning: Killing a bird offering by pinching its neck

steps.whatToRemember: The הזאות in the משנה means a bird offering's sprinkling. We learn it needs a כהן from a קל וחומר: if a sheep, whose שחיטה is open to anyone, still needs a כהן for sprinkling, then surely a bird, whose מליקה needs a כהן, does too.

phrases.english: which comes by an a fortiori argument (kal vachomer) from a sheep offering.
Now if a sheep offering,
for which [the Torah] did not set a priest for its slaughter —
still set a priest for its sprinkling,

phrases.aramaic: בֶּן עוֹף שֶׁקָּבַע לוֹ כֹּהֵן לִמְלִיקָתוֹ –
phrases.english: then a bird offering, for which it did set a priest for its pinching —
phrases.notes: מליקה is how a bird offering is slaughtered: the כהן does it with his fingernail.

phrases.english: is it not logical that it set [a priest] for its sprinkling?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the source showing that a bird offering's sprinkling is limited to כהנים.
steps.raayaObject: A bird offering's sprinkling needs a male כהן, so women may not do it.
steps.raayaSupportSource: A קל וחומר from a sheep offering, whose sprinkling needs a כהן (ויקרא 1:11) even though its slaughter does not.

steps.title: The exception: the meal offerings of a סוטה and a נזירה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה's exception: the מנחת סוטה and the מנחת נזירה are waved by the women themselves.
steps.simpleTranslation: Except for the meal offering of a סוטה and of a נזירה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא turns to the exception in the משנה. This sets up the discussion that follows about where that exception comes from.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה said women don't do these Temple services, but a סוטה and a נזירה do take part in the תנופה (waving) of their own offerings. The גמרא now looks for the source of that.

keyTerms.meaning: The meal offering brought by a woman suspected of adultery
A woman who took a נזיר vow

phrases.english: Except for the meal offering of a sotah and a nazirite woman.
phrases.notes: Quoting the משנה: these women wave their own offering.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from the list of services to the משנה's exception.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A סוטה and a נזירה wave their own offerings, an exception to the rule that women don't do Temple services.

steps.title: רבי אלעזר asks: where does a סוטה's offering need waving?
steps.stepSummary: רבי אלעזר urgently asks רבי יאשיה for the source that a מנחת סוטה needs תנופה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אלעזר said to רבי יאשיה of his generation: Don't sit down until you tell me this teaching. Where do we learn that a סוטה's meal offering needs waving?
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אלעזר presses רבי יאשיה to explain the source for waving a מנחת סוטה before he even sits down.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Taken at face value, the question asks for the source that this offering needs תנופה at all. The next step shows that reading can't be right.

keyTerms.meaning: Don't sit down (literally: on your legs)

phrases.english: Rabbi Elazar said to
Rabbi Yoshiya of his generation:
phrases.notes: This is the אמורא with this name, not the earlier תנא.

phrases.english: Do not sit down on your legs
until you tell me this teaching:
From where [do we know] that the meal offering of a sotah
requires waving?

steps.triggerLanguage: לָא תֵּיתֵיב אַכַּרְעָךְ עַד דְּאָמְרַתְּ לִי לְהָא שְׁמַעְתְּתָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the source of the exception just quoted from the משנה.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What is the source that a מנחת סוטה requires תנופה?

steps.title: But the verse says it openly
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא is surprised at the question: the סוטה section itself says 'והניף את המנחה'.
steps.simpleTranslation: Why ask for a source? It is written in the section itself: 'And he shall wave the meal offering'!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges רבי אלעזר's question. The פסוק openly says the מנחת סוטה is waved, so why ask for a source?
steps.deeperAnalysis: A question needs to ask about something that isn't obvious. Since the פסוק plainly says תנופה, the question can't mean what it seemed to mean.

keyTerms.meaning: From where do we know it?

phrases.english: From where do we know it?!
It is written in its own passage:
"And he shall wave the meal offering"!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the wording of רבי אלעזר's question.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי אלעזר's question asking for a source that a מנחת סוטה needs תנופה.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The פסוק explicitly says 'והניף את המנחה', so the question seems pointless.

steps.title: The real question: waving by the owner
steps.stepSummary: The question is really about where we learn that the owner, the woman herself, does the תנופה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, the question is: where do we learn that the waving is done by the owners?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains what רבי אלעזר was really asking. He wanted to know where we learn that the woman herself takes part in the waving, not only the כהן.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק says 'והניף', 'he shall wave', which could mean only the כהן does it. The משנה says the women wave, so we need a source that the owner is involved. This sets up the discussion that comes next.

keyTerms.meaning: The owners: the person bringing the offering

steps.confusionAlert: Don't think the question is whether a מנחת סוטה is waved at all. That is in the פסוק. The question is who waves it: the woman herself, not only the כהן.

phrases.english: Rather: waving by the owners, from where do we know it?
phrases.notes: The 'owner' here is the woman herself, so the question is about her taking part, not just the כהן.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge by restating what the question really is.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The question seemed to ask whether a מנחת סוטה needs תנופה at all.
steps.terutzMaskana: The question asks for the source that the owner herself takes part in the תנופה.

steps.title: The answer: learn 'hand' from 'hand' in the peace-offering
steps.stepSummary: רבי יאשיה answers that the owner's waving is learned through a גזירה שוה of the word 'יד' between סוטה and שלמים.
steps.simpleTranslation: It is learned from the word 'hand' here and 'hand' there, by the peace-offering. Here, by סוטה, it says 'And the כהן shall take from the woman's hand.' There, by שלמים, it says 'His own hands shall bring it.'
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יאשיה now answers the question from Step 9: how do we know the woman herself waves her מנחה? He points to the same word 'hand' in two different פסוקים.
steps.deeperAnalysis: By סוטה the פסוק says 'from the woman's hand.' By שלמים the פסוק says 'his own hands shall bring it,' talking about the owner. Because the same word 'יד' shows up in both, we may learn the laws of one from the other. This is a גזירה שוה.

keyTerms.meaning: Learning one law from another because the same word appears in both

steps.confusionAlert: 'הכא' (here) means the סוטה פסוק, and 'התם' (there) means the שלמים פסוק. Keep track of which is which, because the next step depends on it.

phrases.english: It is learned from 'hand' 'hand' from the peace-offering.
It is written here: 'And the priest shall take from the woman's hand'
And it is written there: 'His own hands shall bring it.'

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the clarified question from Step 9 about the owner doing the תנופה.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: A גזירה שוה of 'יד' between מנחת סוטה and שלמים.

steps.title: Both cases learn from each other: a priest and the owner
steps.stepSummary: The גזירה שוה works in both directions: from סוטה we learn a כהן waves, and from שלמים we learn the owner waves.
steps.simpleTranslation: Just as here a כהן waves, so too there a כהן waves. Just as there the owner waves, so too here the owner waves.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא shows what each case teaches the other through the shared word 'hand.'
steps.deeperAnalysis: The סוטה פסוק has a כהן waving, so שלמים also needs a כהן. The שלמים פסוק has the owner bringing it with his own hands, so the סוטה woman also takes part in the waving. Now both cases need both people.

phrases.aramaic: מָה כָּאן כֹּהֵן – אַף לְהַלָּן כֹּהֵן,
phrases.english: Just as here, a priest; so too there, a priest.
phrases.notes: 'Here' is the סוטה, 'there' is the peace-offering.

phrases.english: Just as there, the owner;
so too here, the owner.

steps.triggerLanguage: מָה כָּאן כֹּהֵן אַף לְהַלָּן כֹּהֵן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Spells out the two-way result of the גזירה שוה brought in Step 10.
steps.raayaObject: That the owner (the woman) takes part in waving the מנחת סוטה.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The שלמים פסוק 'ידיו תביאנה', linked by the word 'יד'.

steps.title: How can both wave? The priest's hand goes under the owner's
steps.stepSummary: Since both the כהן and the owner must wave, the כהן puts his hand under the owner's hand and they wave together.
steps.simpleTranslation: How does this work? The כהן puts his hand under the owner's hand and waves.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks how two people can both do the waving, and answers right away: they do it together, hands stacked.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The previous step seemed to give the job to two people at once. The answer is that the owner holds the offering, and the כהן's hand goes under the owner's hand, so both are waving at the same moment.

keyTerms.meaning: How so? How does this work?

steps.whyThisMatters: This is the practical picture of תנופה for both שלמים and מנחת סוטה: a joint waving by the כהן and the owner.

phrases.english: How so?
The priest puts his hand
under the hand of the owner and waves.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Resolves the apparent conflict from Step 11, where both the כהן and the owner seem to be required to wave.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Practical harmonization: both people do the act together.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Only one person can actually do the waving, so how can both be required?
steps.terutzMaskana: The כהן's hand goes under the owner's hand, and they wave together.

steps.title: We have a source for סוטה; what about a נזירה?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks how we know that a woman נזיר also waves her own מנחה.
steps.simpleTranslation: We found a source for סוטה. How do we know it for a נזירה?
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה listed two women who wave, סוטה and נזירה. The גמרא has only proven סוטה so far, so it asks for the source for נזירה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The 'יד' גזירה שוה was about the סוטה פסוק only. Nothing yet shows that the same rule applies to a נזירה's offering.

keyTerms.meaning: A woman who took a נזיר vow
From where do we know it?

phrases.english: We have found a source for a סוטה;
from where do we know it for a woman נזיר?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After finishing the source for סוטה, the גמרא moves to the second case listed in the משנה (Step 6).
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The source that a נזירה waves her own offering.

steps.title: נזירה is learned from סוטה through the word 'palm'
steps.stepSummary: A second גזירה שוה, the word 'כף' (palm), teaches that a נזירה waves just like a סוטה.
steps.simpleTranslation: It is learned from the word 'palm' here and 'palm' by סוטה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the word 'palm' appears by נזיר and by סוטה, so the נזירה is learned from the סוטה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: By נזיר the פסוק says the offering is placed 'on the palms of the נזיר,' and by סוטה it says 'on her palms.' Since we already know the סוטה waves, the נזירה does too.
steps.whatToRemember: The מנחת סוטה is waved by the woman together with the כהן (learned from שלמים through 'יד'), and the נזירה is learned from the סוטה through 'כף'.

phrases.english: It is learned from 'palm' 'palm' from סוטה.
phrases.notes: The two פסוקים are במדבר 6:19 for נזיר and במדבר 5:18 for סוטה.

steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: A גזירה שוה of 'כף' links נזירה to סוטה.

steps.title: New משנה: מצוות tied to the land apply only in ארץ ישראל
steps.stepSummary: The new משנה teaches that a מצוה that depends on the land applies only in ארץ ישראל, and a מצוה that does not depend on the land applies everywhere.
steps.simpleTranslation: משנה: Any מצוה that depends on the land applies only in ארץ ישראל. Any מצוה that does not depend on the land applies both in ארץ ישראל and outside of it.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה starts here with a new topic: where in the world a מצוה applies.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה sorts מצוות into two groups. Some are tied to the land, and those apply only in ארץ ישראל. Others are not tied to the land, and those apply in every place.

phrases.english: MISHNA:
Any מצוה that depends on the land
applies only in the land (ארץ ישראל);
and one that does not depend on the land

phrases.aramaic: נוֹהֶגֶת בֵּין בָּאָרֶץ בֵּין בְּחוּצָה לָאָרֶץ,
phrases.english: applies both in the land and outside the land,

steps.triggerLanguage: מַתְנִי׳ כׇּל מִצְוָה שֶׁהִיא תְּלוּיָה בָּאָרֶץ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new משנה with a new topic, after the סוטה and נזירה discussion is finished.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Land-dependent מצוות apply only in ארץ ישראל; all other מצוות apply everywhere.
